pages.title: Contact Select Your Sauna
pages.description: Contact Select Your Sauna about a source, product record or correction.
pages.heading: Questions and corrections
introduction: Please include the page address and the specific product or statement when writing about a correction. That makes it possible to check the underlying source record directly.

sections.heading: Editorial contact
paragraphs: Questions about the research method, documented specifications or source links can be sent by email. Select Your Sauna does not provide electrical, structural or code approval for an installation.
